description: This file defines the `UnknownSignalException` class, which is a specific exception used within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter. It indicates that a given signal is not supported by the adapter. The class includes constructors, builder pattern support, and methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects.

classes.name: UnknownSignalException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when an unsupported signal is encountered in the protocol adapter.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new Builder instance for constructing an UnknownSignalException with support for specifying the signal name.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Constructs an UnknownSignalException from a message string and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an UnknownSignalException from a JSON object and DittoHeaders.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with updated DittoHeaders.

inner_classes.name: Builder
inner_classes.description: A builder class with a fluent API for constructing UnknownSignalException instances, supporting setting message, description, cause, etc.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Overrides to set new DittoHeaders, returning a new exception instance with the updated headers.
